title: Bradesco (BBD) Approves $2 Billion Capital Increase for Digital Push
summary: Banco Bradesco SA said its top investors plan to support a capital raise of as much as 10 billion reais ($2 billion) to help finance the lender’s digital revamp.

title: BOE Governor Bailey on Rates, Uncertainty, Labor Market
summary: Bank of England Governor Andrew Bailey tells Bloomberg's Francine Lacqua there is "huge uncertainty" in the world at the moment, including around energy prices. He also discusses the Monetary Policy Committee's decision to hold interest rates at 3.75% in July and the labor market. "I think we are seeing softness in the labor market," Bailey says.  (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Yen Surge Spurs Speculation Japan Intervened in Market Again
summary: The yen surged by more than 3% against the US dollar, marking its biggest jump since December 2023 and stoking speculation that Japanese officials again intervened in the market.

title: Fed’s Warsh Rebuked by Investors Craving a Real Inflation Fight
summary:
Kevin Warsh’s bare-bones communication style has left investors doubting his commitment to curb inflation, putting more pressure on the new Federal Reserve chairman to back up his words with interest-rate hikes.
Matt Miskin, Co-Chief Investment Strategist John Hancock Investment Management, discusses the divergent equity and bond reaction this morning to the FOMC decision. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Equinix Seeks at Least $3 Billion From Latest Data Center Deal
summary: Data center firm Equinix Inc. is looking to raise at least $3 billion from a sale of US investment-grade bonds, according to people familiar with the matter, selling into a recently weakened environment for debt related to the artificial intelligence boom.

title: From Highest Levy to Duty-Free: Lesotho Lauds US Shift
summary: Products from the tiny southern African mountain kingdom of Lesotho, which had endured the highest tariffs on any nation from the US, can now enter the world’s biggest economy duty-free.

title: Nasdaq 100 Gains 3% as Buyers Emerge After AI Rout: Markets Wrap
summary: Wall Street staged a comeback as dip buyers emerged, lifting stocks as chipmakers rebounded while data signaled the economy remains in good shape, but isn’t overheating.

title: Latest Oil Market News and Analysis for July 30
summary: Oil fluctuated in thin summer trading as signs of increased flows through the Strait of Hormuz offset some concerns over a fresh wave of hostilities from Iran to the Black Sea.

title: US Long-Term Yields Stay Elevated After First Post-Fed Data
summary: Long-term Treasury yields retained most of the surge unleashed by this week’s Federal Reserve rate decision after a raft of US economic data showed still-elevated inflation and labor-market resilience.

title: Odd Lots: How the Iranian Economy Works for Startups
summary:
Over the past decades since the Iranian Revolution of 1979, Iran's economy has completely transformed to resemble what Yeganeh Torbati and Bozorgmehr Sharafedin describe as a "mafia state."

On this episode of the Odd Lots podcast, Torbati, New York Times' Iran correspondent, and Sharafedin, Iran International's head of Digital, join Tracy Alloway and Joe Weisenthal to discuss how the Iranian economy actually works and how startups and business owners have to navigate the network of various factions within political and religious leadership. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Goldman Co-CIO: The Market's Punishing the Hyperscalers

She speaks to Romaine Bostick and Emily Graffeo on Bloomberg's 'The Close.' (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Starbucks Seeing Strong Sales Across the Board, CEO Says
summary: Starbucks CEO Brian Niccol says he is seeing more customers coming into stores more often. Speaking on "Bloomberg Open Interest," Niccol also discusses the company's new products and expresses optimism about 2027. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Oil Holds Gain With Fresh US-Iran Attacks, Kazakh Exports Risk
summary:
Energy markets have been rocked by a fresh round of volatility this month, as investors navigated a short-lived pause in hostilities between Iran and the US, followed by renewed fighting. 
The conflict is spreading beyond the Strait of Hormuz, with Houthi rebels in Yemen threatening a blockade of Saudi Arabia in the Red Sea, while Riyadh’s forces joined with the US to hit targets in Iraq that are linked to Tehran-backed militants.
Paul Sankey, founder at Sankey Research, discusses the Houthi and Saudi escalation and how it's affecting energy. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Carvana Sinks on Forecast; Chipotle Raises Guidance | Stock Movers
summary:
On this episode of Stock Movers:

- Carvana (CVNA) is sinking after the online car retailer gave an annual adjusted Ebitda forecast with a midpoint below analyst estimates. 
- Chipotle (CMG) and Starbucks (SBUX) raised their guidance after stronger-than-expected quarters, with sales bolstered by new menu items and revamped loyalty programs.
- Crocs (CROX) shares are sinking after a soft outlook for this quarter pointed to a weak second half, pushing some investors to sell following a big rally in the company’s shares this year. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Gold Inches Up as Traders Weigh Fed Rate Path After Latest Hold
summary: Gold inched higher as traders weighed the Federal Reserve’s interest-rate path following its latest decision to leave rates unchanged.

title: The BOE Decides | Special Coverage
summary:
The Bank of England kept interest rates steady at 3.75%, as UK officials sought to balance the threat from resurgent US-Iran tensions against signs that domestic price pressures are easing more quickly than predicted. Bloomberg TV brings you Governor Andrew Bailey's press conference live, as well as, all the market reaction and analysis in a special program hosted by the Opening Trade team and a range of experts.

 (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Chile Finance Minister Floats Idea of Private Capital at Codelco
summary: Chile’s right-wing government opened the door to bringing private capital into copper giant Codelco in a way that retains state control, the latest twist in a debate over the indebted company’s future.

title: Ferrari Sees Higher Earnings as Special Models Boost Results
summary: Ferrari NV raised its full-year guidance, as demand for limited-run models like the F80 and a more expensive version of its Purosangue four-seater drove higher second-quarter results.

title: Thoma Bravo Cedes to Revolt on $5 Billion Proofpoint Loan
summary: Thoma Bravo’s Proofpoint Inc. reworked a proposed $5 billion loan refinancing before the deal priced late Wednesday, offering major concessions to lenders increasingly anxious about AI-driven tech disruption.

title: Bailey Says Nothing Suggests BOE Edging Toward a Hike
summary: “Please do not leave this room thinking that the Bank of England is edging toward a hike because there is nothing in what I said or any of us have said along those lines,” Bank of England Governor Andrew Bailey tells reporters after the central bank decided to leave interest rates unchanged on Thursday. (Source: Bloomberg)
